name: Abstention (correct)
one_line: Proportion of genuinely unanswerable queries the system correctly declines.

formula.notation: Abst = |{ q in U : system declined }| / |U|

terms.meaning: the unanswerable subset of the query set
the abstention gate fired rather than an answer being produced

range.note: Mathematical range. No typical value is stated: it would be a number with no run behind it.

ci.why: A point estimate over a few hundred queries without an interval is the first thing a reviewer attacks.
